description: Renderer navigation and the five Crossplane views: App.tsx detection with sequence guard, SecondarySidebar Crossplane group, view labels and header titles, DashboardContent routing, useCrossplaneQuery hook, column helpers, and the Overview, Packages, Definitions, Composites and Managed Resources views. Implements plan.md items 13-15; design B.4, B.4.1-B.4.5, B.5 Detection (App part), B.9 rows for App/SecondarySidebar/DashboardContent/DashboardHeader/view-labels, B.11, and amendments AM-4 (footer, event click, createElement), AM-5 (Definitions composites minIntervalMs 120_000), AM-6 (no 'status'/'replicas' dataKeys). Depends on FEAT-001 and FEAT-002.
steps: Read design.md B.4 (incl. Column conventions), B.4.1-B.4.5, B.5 Detection (App.tsx snippet), B.9 file-plan rows for App.tsx/SecondarySidebar/DashboardContent/DashboardHeader/view-labels/views, B.11, AM-4, AM-5, AM-6; plan.md items 13-15; FEAT-001/002 findings.

src/App.tsx (git status + re-read; additive): useState hasCrossplane next to hasKarpenter; useRef crossplaneDetectSeq; at the start of handleClusterSelect before the getNamespaces pre-flight `const seq = ++crossplaneDetectSeq.current; setHasCrossplane(false);`; after the Karpenter check inside the same try, the window.k8s.crossplane.detect(clusterName) call with seq guard exactly as B.5; in the path that does setSelectedCluster(null) add `crossplaneDetectSeq.current++; setHasCrossplane(false);`; pass hasCrossplane to SecondarySidebar.

src/components/features/sidebar/SecondarySidebar.tsx (git status + re-read; additive): optional prop hasCrossplane; lucide imports Gauge, Package, BookOpen, Boxes, Cloud (only those not already imported); crossplaneGroup { id: 'crossplane', title: 'Crossplane', items for crossplane-overview/packages/definitions/composites/managed }; after the cert-manager block insert via findIndex(g => g.id === 'access') splice as in B.4; openGroups initial state 'crossplane': true.

src/utils/view-labels.ts (re-read; additive): labels Crossplane, XP Packages, XP Definitions, XP Composites, XP Managed for the five ids; run src/utils/view-labels.test.ts (untracked user test) and keep it passing. src/components/dashboard/DashboardHeader.tsx: five titleMap entries from B.4.

Create src/hooks/useCrossplaneQuery.ts per B.11 (fetcherRef, string key, module-level memoised settings promise, resolveIntervalMs, skip ticks when hidden, visibilitychange + shouldFetchOnVisible, request-id stale guard, full cleanup, enabled, keep previous data on error, refresh() forces).

Create src/components/dashboard/views/crossplane/crossplane-columns.ts (col<R>() and healthColumn<R extends CrossplaneRowBase>() whose renderer is createElement(CrossplaneHealthBadge, { health: row.health, reason: row.healthReason }); .ts, no JSX), CrossplaneHealthBadge.tsx (theme status colours, text always present, Pause icon for paused), CrossplaneEmptyState.tsx (Cloud icon, GlassButton secondary 'Retry detection' -> detect(cluster,{force:true})), CrossplaneSectionErrors.tsx (yellow warning card), CrossplaneView.tsx (detection gate via useCrossplaneQuery autoRefresh false, orange-bar header, version badge, Updated TimeAgo, Refresh, sub-view switch; sessionStorage tab key lumen.crossplane.<subView>.tab with fallback to first visible tab).

src/components/dashboard/DashboardContent.tsx (re-read; additive): add 'crossplane' to the ResourceType union; route activeView.startsWith('crossplane-') to <CrossplaneView subView clusterName searchQuery selectedNamespaces onResourceClick onNavigate />, placed like the karpenter branch.

Create CrossplaneOverview.tsx (B.4.1: stat cards per category with onNavigate, core-not-running banner, Operations chip writing lumen.crossplane.composites.tab='operations', Needs attention GenericResourceView in h-[400px] from collectNeedsAttention, AM-4 muted footer '+N more unhealthy managed resources' when scan byHealth unhealthy total > included MR count -> writes lumen.crossplane.managed.selection='unhealthy' then onNavigate('crossplane-managed'), provider health list, Warning events (first 20) clickable only if isValidCrossplaneRef(toCrossplaneRef(involvedObject)) -> onResourceClick(ref,'crossplane'), truncatedScan footnote, scan progress via window.k8s.crossplane.onScanProgress filtered by context with unsubscribe on cleanup; queries per B.11 Overview row).

Create CrossplanePackagesView.tsx (B.4.2 six tabs with ToggleGroup; Activation Policies only when features.mrds), CrossplaneDefinitionsView.tsx (B.4.3; definitions query + composites query with minIntervalMs: 120_000 per AM-5; renderer joins for composition/instance counts), CrossplaneCompositesView.tsx (B.4.4; kind filter select; Claims hidden when !claimsSupported; Usages hidden when no Usage API; Operations tab with inner Operations|Cron|Watch toggle only when features.operations), CrossplaneManagedView.tsx + CrossplaneKindTree.tsx (B.4.5; Virtuoso provider->kind list, All unhealthy and Unattributed pseudo-entries, inactive kinds text-gray-600, Show empty kinds toggle, truncation banner, getManagedItems for the selected kind; honours lumen.crossplane.managed.selection).

All tables use GenericResourceView with module-level `const X_COLUMNS: IColumn[] = [col<Row>(...)]`; health column dataKey 'healthOrder'; count columns numeric fields; NO column uses dataKey 'status' or 'replicas'; row click -> onResourceClick(row, 'crossplane'); derived data in useMemo, callbacks in useCallback.
acceptance_criteria: `npx tsc --noEmit` exits 0 and `npx vite build` succeeds.
`npx vitest run` passes (incl. the user's src/utils/view-labels.test.ts).

No Crossplane column definition uses dataKey 'status' or 'replicas'; Definitions view passes minIntervalMs: 120_000 to the composites query.
git diff of App.tsx, SecondarySidebar.tsx, view-labels.ts, DashboardContent.tsx, DashboardHeader.tsx shows only additive insertions on top of the user's existing hunks.
verification: npm run lint 2>&1 | tail -3   (total must be <= 1608 problems)
findings:
FILES (new, uncommitted): src/hooks/useCrossplaneQuery.ts (130); src/components/dashboard/views/crossplane/: CrossplaneView.tsx (119), CrossplaneOverview.tsx (293), CrossplanePackagesView.tsx (146), CrossplaneDefinitionsView.tsx (141), CrossplaneCompositesView.tsx (218), CrossplaneManagedView.tsx (151), CrossplaneKindTree.tsx (126), CrossplaneHealthBadge.tsx (43, also exports CrossplaneConditionPill), CrossplaneEmptyState.tsx (32), CrossplaneSectionErrors.tsx (28), crossplane-columns.ts (76), crossplane-view-state.ts (69, extra helper module not in the file plan: sub-view props type, sessionStorage helpers, useCrossplaneTab, useRefreshSignal, useReportStatus). All < 500 lines, no `any`.

MODIFIED (additive str_replace only): src/App.tsx (hasCrossplane state + crossplaneDetectSeq ref next to hasKarpenter; `const seq = ++crossplaneDetectSeq.current; setHasCrossplane(false);` before the getNamespaces try; seq-guarded detect() after the Karpenter check; onBack increments seq + clears flag; hasCrossplane prop to SecondarySidebar. The other setSelectedCluster(null) path (kubeconfig context removed, ~line 85) was left untouched). SecondarySidebar.tsx (hasCrossplane?: boolean prop; lucide Gauge, BookOpen, Boxes, Cloud added — Package was already imported; crossplaneGroup spliced before 'access' after the cert-manager block; openGroups 'crossplane': true). src/utils/view-labels.ts (5 labels). DashboardHeader.tsx (5 titleMap entries). DashboardContent.tsx (import, 'crossplane' in ResourceType, `activeView.startsWith('crossplane-')` route after the karpenter branch). ALSO src/components/Dashboard.tsx: added only `'crossplane'` to the handleResourceClick type union (required for tsc once DashboardContent's ResourceType gained it; this is the same token FEAT-004 B.9 plans). No Crossplane branch yet, so until FEAT-004 a row click opens the drawer with no details loaded.

COMPONENT API: <CrossplaneView subView clusterName searchQuery selectedNamespaces onResourceClick(resource: CrossplaneObjectRef, 'crossplane') onNavigate? />. Unknown subView -> overview. Detection gate uses useCrossplaneQuery(detect, `${cluster}|detect`, {autoRefresh:false}); spinner while loading, CrossplaneEmptyState when !installed or detect failed (Retry -> detect(cluster,{force:true}) via refresh()). Header: orange bar, title, version badge (version or vN.x), 'Updated <TimeAgo> ago' (newest payload fetchedAt reported by the sub-view), Refresh (forces detect + increments refreshSignal, which forces every query of the visible sub-view). Sub-views take CrossplaneSubViewProps {clusterName, detection, searchQuery, selectedNamespaces, onResourceClick, onNavigate?, refreshSignal, onStatus}. Rows are passed to onResourceClick as-is (row objects with apiVersion/kind/name/namespace/category, no metadata); FEAT-004's Dashboard branch must apply toCrossplaneRef. Warning-event click passes toCrossplaneRef(involvedObject).

useCrossplaneQuery<T>(fetcher(force), key, {autoRefresh=true, minIntervalMs, enabled=true}) -> {data, error, loading, refreshing, refresh}. fetcherRef; module-level memoised settings.getAll() promise (refreshInterval, fallback 30); resolveIntervalMs; interval skipped when hidden; visibilitychange + shouldFetchOnVisible; request-id guard (invalidated on key change/unmount); key change resets data; error keeps previous data; refresh() is the only force=true caller.

COLUMNS (crossplane-columns.ts): col<R>(), healthColumn<R>(label='Health', dataKey='healthOrder', pick) using createElement(CrossplaneHealthBadge,{health, reason}); conditionColumn, ageColumn, textColumn, countColumn ('—' for non-number), timeColumn. Providers Rev. Health uses dataKey 'revisionHealthOrder'. No column uses dataKey 'status' or 'replicas' (grep-checked). Count columns use numeric fields: installedDefinitionCount, usedByCount, depsInstalled, userCount, activatedCount, compositionCount/instanceCount (renderer join, Map-based), revisionCount, xrCount, stepCount, keyCount, resourceRefCount, runningCount, watchingResources.

SESSIONSTORAGE KEYS: lumen.crossplane.<subView>.tab (packages, definitions, composites; unknown/hidden stored tab falls back to first visible without overwriting); Overview Operations chip writes lumen.crossplane.composites.tab='operations' then onNavigate('crossplane-composites'); lumen.crossplane.managed.selection ('unhealthy' or a kindKey; the AM-4 '+N more unhealthy managed resources' footer writes 'unhealthy' then onNavigate('crossplane-managed')).

VIEW NOTES: Overview queries packages, definitions, composites, scanManaged (minIntervalMs 300_000), getWarningEvents (first 20 shown), subscribes onScanProgress filtered by context with unsubscribe on cleanup. Definitions: composites query with minIntervalMs: 120_000 (AM-5). Composites: Claims tab only when definitions.claimsSupported, Usages when protectionUsages||legacyUsages, Operations (inner Operations|Cron|Watch toggle) when features.operations; kind filter keyed group|kind on XR/Claims tabs. Managed: getManagedKinds + scanManaged (300_000), getManagedItems(cluster,[kindKey]) only for active kinds (inactive kindKeys `group//plural` would fail KIND_KEY validation, so an inactive kind shows an explanatory card instead); Virtuoso kind tree with All unhealthy pseudo-entry, Unattributed group, inactive kinds text-gray-600, Show empty kinds toggle (empty kinds hidden only once scan status is complete); default selection All unhealthy if non-empty else first kind with count > 0.
